result_text:
I changed the mock-folder rule in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (around line 393). I did not write a new test or run any of your example paths through the rule. Running `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='*Scoping*'` produced no output, and I didn't check whether that pattern actually ran any tests.

The two path patterns that decided what counts as a mock folder were `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*`. They required at least one character from a short ASCII set after `mock`. I replaced that set with `[^/\\]*`, so they are now `.*/__mock[^/\\]*/.*` and `.*/mock[^/\\]*/.*`. Reading the patterns:

- **Newly matched:** plain `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/` and `mock-größe/` or `mock模拟/` match, at any depth.
- **Still matched:** `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` match as before.
- **Still not matched:** the rule must start at a `/` right before `mock`, so `remock/`, `demo/` and `src/main/java/` don't match. `mock.java` and `mockery.java` don't match either, because the pattern needs a `/` after the folder name.
- **Backslash paths:** `SourceFileFilter.matches` already tries both path separators, so I left it alone.
